summary: Keep socket, PTY and checkpoint regression fixtures portable on macOS

replay.detail: Test fixtures only; no replay changes.

rules.detail: No rules, checkpoints or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Unix-socket fixtures use short temporary roots independent of TMPDIR. The late-PTY fixture restores its test runner's dynamic-library fallback path after the shell boundary. Checkpoint verification expects the native macOS clone backend rather than the Linux fallback. Production behavior and all non-platform test assertions remain unchanged.
